what: Positional harness paths conflict with unchanged scan_file path join
scenario_or_breakage: Plan tests call `bash "$LINT" "$TMPROOT/scripts/..."` without `--root`, but `scan_file` always reads `$ROOT/$rel` with default `ROOT=$REPO_ROOT`; absolute fixture paths are outside the repo so `[[ -f "$path" ]]` fails and the hook returns 0 — violation case false-negative and “sibling not scanned” case gives no signal
suggested_fix: Invoke positional harness cases as `bash "$LINT" --root "$TMPROOT" scripts/good.sh` (etc.), or teach `scan_file` to use absolute `path` when `rel` is absolute / outside `$ROOT` (plan’s fallback is not spelled as a `scan_file` edit)
